decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program sits close to the firm's core door business, and the firm's in-house R&D lets it interpret results and refine delivery logistics, though it could be folded into the broader express program.
The seventy-two-hour delivery builds directly on existing manufacturing and logistics knowledge and remained listed in 2024, so management can assimilate feedback and keep improving it.
The express program for doors and gates has had its own page in both years and draws on core competencies, making it a stable extension of the established offer.
The online ordering platform builds on the firm's established offer and service network and keeps a dedicated page, so the firm can learn from its use and develop it further.
The fire and smoke protection door is close to the firm's safety-certified core expertise and gained its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment that in-house R&D can support.
